<thought>To find the template for electrophilic aromatic bromination, I will search the template catalog for a reaction that forms a halide (bromine) on an aromatic ring. The target product is likely bromobenzene (c1ccccc1Br). Using the search tool with functional_groups_formed set to “halide” should retrieve relevant templates, from which I can obtain the template_id and then map the reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccccc1Br",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["halide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
